description: This file defines the ADODB_Compress_Gzip class, which handles gzip compression and decompression of data within the ADOdb PHP database abstraction library, specifically for session management.

classes.name: ADODB_Compress_Gzip
classes.description: A class providing gzip compression and decompression functionalities with configurable compression level and minimum data length.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the current compression level setting.

methods.name: setLevel
methods.description: Sets the compression level between 0 and 9.

methods.name: getMinLength
methods.description: Returns the minimum data length for compression to be applied.

methods.name: setMinLength
methods.description: Sets the minimum data length for compression.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that optionally initializes compression level and minimum length.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Compresses the data using gzip if it exceeds the minimum length; otherwise returns data unchanged.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Decompresses data if it has been compressed.
